SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

   A. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat School and Community as rumours only.

   A. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

   A. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

14. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

16. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Traditional forms of Government and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Regional co- operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
